page.layout: One scan showing the inside of a book cover, with a leather board and a blank paper pastedown; no printed text block. Handwritten shelf mark in the upper left corner (not transcribed, as it is not printed).
page.notes: The scan shows the rear or front board of a binding: dark leather turn-ins at the top, right and bottom edges, and a pale paper pastedown with stains, paper flaws and small spots. Only a pencilled library shelf mark ("J621 / K255") appears in the upper left, which is handwriting and therefore not transcribed. Remaining marks are stains and pale patches left by former label or tape pieces. No printed text is present.
